ar: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ وَٱلذَّٰرِيَٰتِ ذَرْوًا
en: (1) By the [winds] scattering [dust], dispersing [it]

ar: فَٱلْحَٰمِلَٰتِ وِقْرًا
en: (2) And the [clouds] carrying a load [of water]

ar: فَٱلْجَٰرِيَٰتِ يُسْرًا
en: (3) And the ships sailing with ease

ar: فَٱلْمُقَسِّمَٰتِ أَمْرًا
en: (4) And the [angels] apportioning [each] matter,

ar: إِنَّمَا تُوعَدُونَ لَصَادِقٌ
en: (5) Indeed, what you are promised is true.

ar: وَإِنَّ ٱلدِّينَ لَوَٰقِعٌ
en: (6) And indeed, the recompense is to occur.

ar: وَٱلسَّمَآءِ ذَاتِ ٱلْحُبُكِ
en: (7) By the heaven containing pathways,[1535]
enNotes: [1535]- Explained as tracks, layers or orbits.

ar: إِنَّكُمْ لَفِى قَوْلٍ مُّخْتَلِفٍ
en: (8) Indeed, you are in differing speech.[1536]
enNotes: [1536]- About Prophet Muḥammad (ﷺ) and the Qur’ān.

ar: يُؤْفَكُ عَنْهُ مَنْ أُفِكَ
en: (9) Deluded away from it [i.e., the Qur’ān] is he who is deluded.

ar: قُتِلَ ٱلْخَرَّٰصُونَ
en: (10) Destroyed are the misinformers[1537]

ar: ٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ فِى غَمْرَةٍ سَاهُونَ
en: (11) Who are within a flood [of confusion] and heedless.

ar: يَسْـَٔلُونَ أَيَّانَ يَوْمُ ٱلدِّينِ
en: (12) They ask, "When is the Day of Recompense?"

ar: يَوْمَ هُمْ عَلَى ٱلنَّارِ يُفْتَنُونَ
en: (13) [It is] the Day they will be tormented over the Fire

ar: ذُوقُوا۟ فِتْنَتَكُمْ هَٰذَا ٱلَّذِى كُنتُم بِهِۦ تَسْتَعْجِلُونَ
en: (14) [And will be told], "Taste your torment. This is that for which you were impatient."
tr: Dhūqū fitnatakum, hādhal-ladhī kuntum bihī tastaʿjilūn

ar: إِنَّ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ فِى جَنَّٰتٍ وَعُيُونٍ
en: (15) Indeed, the righteous will be among gardens and springs,

ar: ءَاخِذِينَ مَآ ءَاتَىٰهُمْ رَبُّهُمْ إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوا۟ قَبْلَ ذَٰلِكَ مُحْسِنِينَ
en: (16) Accepting what their Lord has given them. Indeed, they were before that doers of good.
tr: Ākhidhīna mā ātāhum rabbuhum, innahum kānū qabla dhālika muḥsinīn

ar: كَانُوا۟ قَلِيلًا مِّنَ ٱلَّيْلِ مَا يَهْجَعُونَ
en: (17) They used to sleep but little of the night,[1538]
enNotes: [1538]- i.e., spending a portion of the night in prayer and supplication.

ar: وَبِٱلْأَسْحَارِ هُمْ يَسْتَغْفِرُونَ
en: (18) And in the hours before dawn they would ask forgiveness,

ar: وَفِىٓ أَمْوَٰلِهِمْ حَقٌّ لِّلسَّآئِلِ وَٱلْمَحْرُومِ
en: (19) And from their properties was [given] the right of the [needy] petitioner and the deprived.

ar: وَفِى ٱلْأَرْضِ ءَايَٰتٌ لِّلْمُوقِنِينَ
en: (20) And on the earth are signs for the certain [in faith]

ar: وَفِىٓ أَنفُسِكُمْ أَفَلَا تُبْصِرُونَ
en: (21) And in yourselves. Then will you not see?

ar: وَفِى ٱلسَّمَآءِ رِزْقُكُمْ وَمَا تُوعَدُونَ
en: (22) And in the heaven is your provision and whatever you are promised.

ar: فَوَرَبِّ ٱلسَّمَآءِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ إِنَّهُۥ لَحَقٌّ مِّثْلَ مَآ أَنَّكُمْ تَنطِقُونَ
en: (23) Then by the Lord of the heaven and earth, indeed, it is truth - just as [sure as] it is that you are speaking.
tr: Fawarabbis-samāʾi wal-arḍi innahū laḥaqqum mithla mā annakum tanṭiqūn

ar: هَلْ أَتَىٰكَ حَدِيثُ ضَيْفِ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ ٱلْمُكْرَمِينَ
en: (24) Has there reached you the story of the honored guests of Abraham?[1539] -
enNotes: [1539]- Who were angels given honored positions by Allāh.

ar: إِذْ دَخَلُوا۟ عَلَيْهِ فَقَالُوا۟ سَلَٰمًا قَالَ سَلَٰمٌ قَوْمٌ مُّنكَرُونَ
en: (25) When they entered upon him and said, "[We greet you with] peace." He answered, "[And upon you] peace; [you are] a people unknown."
tr: Idh dakhalū ʿalayhi faqālū salāmā, qāla salām, qawmum munkarūn

ar: فَرَاغَ إِلَىٰٓ أَهْلِهِۦ فَجَآءَ بِعِجْلٍ سَمِينٍ
en: (26) Then he went to his family and came with a fat [roasted] calf.
tr: Farāgha ilā ahlihī fajāʾa biʿijlin samīn

ar: فَقَرَّبَهُۥٓ إِلَيْهِمْ قَالَ أَلَا تَأْكُلُونَ
en: (27) And placed it near them; he said, "Will you not eat?"

ar: فَأَوْجَسَ مِنْهُمْ خِيفَةً قَالُوا۟ لَا تَخَفْ وَبَشَّرُوهُ بِغُلَٰمٍ عَلِيمٍ
en: (28) And he felt from them apprehension.[1540] They said, "Fear not," and gave him good tidings of a learned boy.
tr: Faʾawjasa minhum khīfah, qālū lā takhaf, wabashsharūhu bighulāmin ʿalīm

ar: فَأَقْبَلَتِ ٱمْرَأَتُهُۥ فِى صَرَّةٍ فَصَكَّتْ وَجْهَهَا وَقَالَتْ عَجُوزٌ عَقِيمٌ
en: (29) And his wife approached with a cry [of alarm] and struck her face and said, "[I am] a barren old woman!"
tr: Faʾaqbalatimraʾatuhū fī ṣarratin faṣakkat wajhahā waqālat ʿajūzun ʿaqīm

ar: قَالُوا۟ كَذَٰلِكِ قَالَ رَبُّكِ إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلْحَكِيمُ ٱلْعَلِيمُ
en: (30) They said, "Thus has said your Lord; indeed, He is the Wise, the Knowing."
tr: Qālū kadhāliki qāla rabbuk, innahū huwal-ḥakīmul-ʿalīm

ar: قَالَ فَمَا خَطْبُكُمْ أَيُّهَا ٱلْمُرْسَلُونَ
en: (31) [Abraham] said, "Then what is your business [here], O messengers?"

ar: قَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّآ أُرْسِلْنَآ إِلَىٰ قَوْمٍ مُّجْرِمِينَ
en: (32) They said, "Indeed, we have been sent to a people of criminals[1541]
enNotes: [1541]- i.e., those who defied Lot (upon him be peace).
tr: Qālū innā ursilnā ilā qawmim mujrimīn

ar: لِنُرْسِلَ عَلَيْهِمْ حِجَارَةً مِّن طِينٍ
en: (33) To send down upon them stones of clay,

ar: مُّسَوَّمَةً عِندَ رَبِّكَ لِلْمُسْرِفِينَ
en: (34) Marked in the presence of your Lord for the transgressors."

ar: فَأَخْرَجْنَا مَن كَانَ فِيهَا مِنَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
en: (35) So We brought out whoever was in them [i.e., the cities] of the believers.

ar: فَمَا وَجَدْنَا فِيهَا غَيْرَ بَيْتٍ مِّنَ ٱلْمُسْلِمِينَ
en: (36) And We found not within them other than a [single] house of Muslims.[1542]
enNotes: [1542]- i.e., Lot and his family, excepting his wife.
tr: Famā wajadnā fīhā ghayra baytim minal-muslimīn

ar: وَتَرَكْنَا فِيهَآ ءَايَةً لِّلَّذِينَ يَخَافُونَ ٱلْعَذَابَ ٱلْأَلِيمَ
en: (37) And We left therein a sign for those who fear the painful punishment.

ar: وَفِى مُوسَىٰٓ إِذْ أَرْسَلْنَٰهُ إِلَىٰ فِرْعَوْنَ بِسُلْطَٰنٍ مُّبِينٍ
en: (38) And in Moses [was a sign], when We sent him to Pharaoh with clear authority.[1543]
tr: Wafī mūsā idh arsalnāhu ilā firʿawna bisulṭānim mubīn

ar: فَتَوَلَّىٰ بِرُكْنِهِۦ وَقَالَ سَٰحِرٌ أَوْ مَجْنُونٌ
en: (39) But he turned away with his supporters and said, "A magician or a madman."
tr: Fatawallā biruknihī waqāla sāḥirun aw majnūn

ar: فَأَخَذْنَٰهُ وَجُنُودَهُۥ فَنَبَذْنَٰهُمْ فِى ٱلْيَمِّ وَهُوَ مُلِيمٌ
en: (40) So We took him and his soldiers and cast them into the sea, and he was blameworthy.
tr: Faʾakhadhnāhu wajunūdahū fanabadhnāhum fil-yammi wahuwa mulīm

ar: وَفِى عَادٍ إِذْ أَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمُ ٱلرِّيحَ ٱلْعَقِيمَ
en: (41) And in ʿAad [was a sign], when We sent against them the barren wind.[1544]
enNotes: [1544]- Barren of any benefit, i.e., evil.

ar: مَا تَذَرُ مِن شَىْءٍ أَتَتْ عَلَيْهِ إِلَّا جَعَلَتْهُ كَٱلرَّمِيمِ
en: (42) It left nothing of what it came upon but that it made it like disintegrated ruins.
tr: Mā tadharu min shayʾin atat ʿalayhi illā jaʿalathu kar-ramīm

ar: وَفِى ثَمُودَ إِذْ قِيلَ لَهُمْ تَمَتَّعُوا۟ حَتَّىٰ حِينٍ
en: (43) And in Thamūd, when it was said to them, "Enjoy yourselves for a time."
tr: Wafī thamūda idh qīla lahum tamattaʿū ḥattā ḥīn

ar: فَعَتَوْا۟ عَنْ أَمْرِ رَبِّهِمْ فَأَخَذَتْهُمُ ٱلصَّٰعِقَةُ وَهُمْ يَنظُرُونَ
en: (44) But they were insolent toward the command of their Lord, so the thunderbolt seized them while they were looking on.
tr: Faʿataw ʿan amri rabbihim faʾakhadhathumuṣ-ṣāʿiqatu wahum yanẓurūn

ar: فَمَا ٱسْتَطَٰعُوا۟ مِن قِيَامٍ وَمَا كَانُوا۟ مُنتَصِرِينَ
en: (45) And they were unable to arise, nor could they defend themselves.
tr: Famastaṭāʿū min qiyāmiw wamā kānū muntaṣirīn

ar: وَقَوْمَ نُوحٍ مِّن قَبْلُ إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوا۟ قَوْمًا فَٰسِقِينَ
en: (46) And [We destroyed] the people of Noah before; indeed, they were a people defiantly disobedient.
tr: Waqawma nūḥim min qabl, innahum kānū qawman fāsiqīn

ar: وَٱلسَّمَآءَ بَنَيْنَٰهَا بِأَيْي۟دٍ وَإِنَّا لَمُوسِعُونَ
en: (47) And the heaven We constructed with strength,[1545] and indeed, We are [its] expander.

ar: وَٱلْأَرْضَ فَرَشْنَٰهَا فَنِعْمَ ٱلْمَٰهِدُونَ
en: (48) And the earth We have spread out, and excellent is the preparer.

ar: وَمِن كُلِّ شَىْءٍ خَلَقْنَا زَوْجَيْنِ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَذَكَّرُونَ
en: (49) And of all things We created two mates [i.e., counterparts]; perhaps you will remember.
tr: Wamin kulli shayʾin khalaqnā zawjayni laʿallakum tadhakkarūn

ar: فَفِرُّوٓا۟ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ إِنِّى لَكُم مِّنْهُ نَذِيرٌ مُّبِينٌ
en: (50) So flee to Allāh.[1546] Indeed, I am to you from Him a clear warner.
enNotes: [1546]- i.e., turn to Allāh and take refuge in Him from disbelief and sin, thereby escaping His punishment.
tr: Fafirrū ilallāh, innī lakum minhu nadhīrum mubīn

ar: وَلَا تَجْعَلُوا۟ مَعَ ٱللَّهِ إِلَٰهًا ءَاخَرَ إِنِّى لَكُم مِّنْهُ نَذِيرٌ مُّبِينٌ
en: (51) And do not make [as equal] with Allāh another deity. Indeed, I am to you from Him a clear warner.
tr: Walā tajʿalū maʿallāhi ilāhan ākhar, innī lakum minhu nadhīrum mubīn

ar: كَذَٰلِكَ مَآ أَتَى ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِهِم مِّن رَّسُولٍ إِلَّا قَالُوا۟ سَاحِرٌ أَوْ مَجْنُونٌ
en: (52) Similarly, there came not to those before them any messenger except that they said, "A magician or a madman."
tr: Kadhālika mā atal-ladhīna min qablihim mir rasūlin illā qālū sāḥirun aw majnūn

ar: أَتَوَاصَوْا۟ بِهِۦ بَلْ هُمْ قَوْمٌ طَاغُونَ
en: (53) Did they suggest it to them?[1547] Rather, they [themselves] are a transgressing people.
enNotes: [1547]- i.e., Did the former disbelievers pass on these words to the Makkans so that they repeat the same expressions?
tr: Atawāṣaw bih, bal hum qawmun ṭāghūn

ar: فَتَوَلَّ عَنْهُمْ فَمَآ أَنتَ بِمَلُومٍ
en: (54) So leave them, [O Muḥammad], for you are not to be blamed.

ar: وَذَكِّرْ فَإِنَّ ٱلذِّكْرَىٰ تَنفَعُ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
en: (55) And remind, for indeed, the reminder benefits the believers.

ar: وَمَا خَلَقْتُ ٱلْجِنَّ وَٱلْإِنسَ إِلَّا لِيَعْبُدُونِ
en: (56) And I did not create the jinn and mankind except to worship Me.

ar: مَآ أُرِيدُ مِنْهُم مِّن رِّزْقٍ وَمَآ أُرِيدُ أَن يُطْعِمُونِ
en: (57) I do not want from them any provision, nor do I want them to feed Me.
tr: Mā urīdu minhum mir rizqiw wamā urīdu ay yuṭʿimūn

ar: إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ هُوَ ٱلرَّزَّاقُ ذُو ٱلْقُوَّةِ ٱلْمَتِينُ
en: (58) Indeed, it is Allāh who is the [continual] Provider,[1548] the firm possessor of strength.
enNotes: [1548]- Providing everything required by His creations during their decreed existence. His provision includes guidance.

ar: فَإِنَّ لِلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا۟ ذَنُوبًا مِّثْلَ ذَنُوبِ أَصْحَٰبِهِمْ فَلَا يَسْتَعْجِلُونِ
en: (59) And indeed, for those who have wronged is a portion [of punishment] like the portion of their companions [i.e., predecessors], so let them not impatiently urge Me.
tr: Faʾinna lilladhīna ẓalamū dhanūbam mithla dhanūbi aṣḥābihim falā yastaʿjilūn

ar: فَوَيْلٌ لِّلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ مِن يَوْمِهِمُ ٱلَّذِى يُوعَدُونَ
en: (60) And woe to those who have disbelieved from their Day which they are promised.
tr: Fawaylul lilladhīna kafarū miy yawmihimul-ladhī yūʿadūn
